subject: Proposal: on-ramp voucher + short extension to finalize Acme Media deal
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: approve on-ramp voucher + short extension for Acme Media

Team —

Acme (contact: Daniel Park) is asking for a small commercial sweetener to move the PO across the finish line before the end of the quarter. Quick context: their POC usage is healthy (see Rachel's numbers) and legal/procurement are asking for a simple pricing addendum before they sign. Daniel indicated in today's call that an additional on-ramp voucher + a short trial extension would remove the last internal blocker.

Asks: can we approve the following so I can present a firm offer to Acme?
- On-ramp voucher: $12,000 in usage credit applied to first 60 days after activation
- Trial extension: 60-day extension of trial access for their pilot project (no SLA change)
- Conditions: voucher expires if not consumed within 90 days and is only redeemable by Acme Media for production usage on Redwood-hosted endpoints

Attachments: onramp_voucher_acme_20261029.pdf (proposal), acme_consumption_estimates.xlsx (Rachel)

Business rationale: 
- High conversion probability: engineering is already integrated and sent positive evaluation.
- Expected ARR uplift: conservatively $180k annually if conversion occurs within 90 days (see Rachel's estimates).
- Cost to Redwood: estimated token cost roughly $2,800 if they consume $12k of invoiced usage in first 60 days.

Timeline: Acme wants firm terms by EOD Friday (2026-10-30) to route through their procurement team. I will hold the offer public-facing until we get internal approval.

Please reply with (approve / reduce / decline) and any edits to the conditions. If approved, I'll raise the DocuSign and add the line item to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, West
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approve on-ramp voucher + short extension for Acme Media

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few follow-ups before I can sign off: 
1) Can we quantify the ARR uplift you referenced (attach the conservative/worse-case numbers) and confirm this doesn't set a precedent for automatic trial extensions?
2) Legal: is the voucher language straightforward (no data residency carveouts) — please loop legal if there are any bespoke terms.
3) Finance: prefer we keep the voucher ≤ $12k where possible. If you can show >2x expected ARR within 12 months vs cost, I'm more comfortable.

If you want a faster path, propose a milestone-based voucher (e.g., $8k upfront + $4k once ACV target met) — that may be acceptable to finance.

Please send the short playbook and I'll aim to respond by 5 PM today.

Marissa
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approve on-ramp voucher + short extension for Acme Media

Marissa / Kim —

I attached a short workbook (acme_consumption_estimates.xlsx) with three scenarios based on observed POC token rates and projected seat growth. Highlights: 
- POC consumption monthly (avg): ~$3,200 billed usage (projected)
- If production ramps to just 2x POC usage within 60 days, billed usage would be ~ $6,400/mo ⇒ ~ $76k ARR (conservative pricing)
- If usage scales to 4x POC within 90 days, that maps to ~$152k ARR.

Given those numbers, a $12k voucher buys us roughly one quarter of their early production consumption and materially reduces their perceived risk. My recommendation: approve the $12k voucher with a 60-day extension OR move to milestone split ($8k now / $4k at 90-day usage threshold). Both protect Redwood and give Acme a clear runway.

Technical note: no special infra change required; their model runs fine on current host config. No data residency add-ons were requested in the POC.

-Rachel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmemedia.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approve on-ramp voucher + short extension for Acme Media

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick review. Two small updates after speaking with Daniel this morning (pasted his note from the Acme thread below):
1) Acme prefers a single voucher rather than a split milestone — simplifies procurement for them.
2) They asked for 60-day extension specifically to align the voucher activation window to internal release cadence.

Counterproposal I recommend we present to Acme (if you agree):
- Voucher: $12,000 usage credit applied within first 60 days after redemption
- Trial extension: 60 days
- Expiration: voucher void if not consumed within 90 days of activation
- Refunds/credits: voucher is non-refundable and applies only to usage fees; no changes to base contract pricing or SLAs

If that looks good, I'll route DocuSign, add the line to HubSpot (link below), and send to procurement.

Quoted from Daniel Park (Acme) — internal forward: 

"On Fri, Oct 30, 2026 at 07:52 AM Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmemedia.com> wrote:
> Kim —
> Appreciate the responsiveness. The team is happy with the POC signals. If we can get a 60-day extension + an on-ramp credit that helps us cover the first burst of usage around our release, we can sign the SOW next week. Procurement just needs a simple credit addendum.
> Thanks,
> Daniel

Next steps if approved: I will prepare the addendum and request Procurement to sign ASAP.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, West
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approve on-ramp voucher + short extension for Acme Media — APPROVED

Kimberly —

Approved. Offer the $12,000 on-ramp voucher + 60-day extension with the expiration clause you outlined. Please include the following in the DocuSign addendum: 
- Voucher redemption window and expiration (as above)
- Non-transferability clause
- Clause confirming voucher applies only to usage on Redwood-hosted endpoints

Operational asks: 
1) Create the addendum using the onramp_template_docx.docx and route via DocuSign to procurement@acme-media.com and Daniel Park.
2) Log the line item in HubSpot and update deal stage to "Contracting - awaiting signature" (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890/detail/ACME-2026-Q4-058).
3) Finance: I'll flag the voucher in the monthly revenue forecast.

Thanks for running point — close it out and send me the signed counterparty when complete.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
